11/18/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, sitting in back corner of kennel with tense body. Handler crouched, spoke softly, tried coaxing, tossed treats. Dog remained in back of kennel. Handler opened gate, neutrally presented leash. Dog pulled back, wide-eyed. Handler used sort board as barrier, stepped into kennel, gently brushed dog's side with end of leash; dog whipped head back and bit at leash. Handler removed leash gave dog a few moments to settle, then used large loop to quickly lasso leash. Dog bit towards leash, then settled, stared at handler. Would not initially exit kennel, then slowly stepped out as handler was positioning behavior taxi. Dog walked a couple feet, then froze, retreated into kennel. Handler attempted to guide dog towards taxi; dog fought leash and whipped head, crying out, biting at leash. Handler released leash tension, spoke gently, used sort board to gently guide dog towards taxi. Dog cried out again, thrashed on leash, bit edge of sort board. Handler gave dog some time to settle, then was able to guide dog into taxi with sort board. Dog rode well, stoic, staring at handler. Took to J-yard without issue, stepped out of taxi into yard. Dog explored with neutral body language, remained at least 5 feet away from handler at all times. Handler sat on chair, gave dog time. Handler spoke softly, tossed treats, dog was not interested. Dog continued to sniff yard, tail down, frequently staring of handler, vigilant of their position. After a few more minutes, handler stood, slowly approached, dog tucked tail and scurried away, wide-eyed. Handler was able to pick up leash, dog directed self into taxi. Once dog appeared to settle in taxi, handler slowly moved hand towards dog but kept distance, dog quickly stiffed and flagged tail, brief lip curl. Handler did not force interaction. Dog rode well on return, needed light leash pressure to exit into kennel. Handler used extension tool to remove leash; dog lightly bit at tool as leash was being pulled away.
11/17/2026
Closed out for AM cleaning. Laying in back corner of kennel; curled up; tossed treats; reached for treats tossed nearby; would not approach; whale eyed; opened kennel door; continued to toss treats; slowly stepped a foot in to be able to reach; tossed treat; able to use a large loop while handler tossed treats; dog slowly rose; growling; biting at leash; leashed; settled once leash was on; sat towards back of kennel; applied light leash guidance; thrashed; handler placed behavior taxi right at front of kennel; handler stepped in with a sort board to guide; dog walked right into behavior taxi; rode well; ears back; whale eyed; watched handler. In yard, dog exited taxi; explored; stayed on opposite end from handler; sniffing nose to ground; teeth chattering; handler tossed treats nearby; not interested; sat in corner of yard; handler started to approach; crouched nearby; dog watched handler; continued to explore; would not approach handler; after a few moments; handler slowly moved closer; dog sat against fence; handler slowly extended hand out; sniffed; slowly pet lower end; dog watched handler's hand entire time; lip licking; skin crawled; continued to slowly pet for a moment; stopped petting; handler walked away; dog remained in place. Handler brought over taxi; picked leash up; dog moved away; pulled on leash; soft whining; handler crouched; allowed handler to slowly pet on head; placed taxi right next to dog; applied light leash guidance; soft whined; walked in; rode well back to kennel; entered kennel; scurried to back corner; started to come forward; handler stepped in; reached hand out; sniffed; allowed handler to slowly remove leash by hand.
11/15/2026
Called over radio for assistance with shifting dog over for AM cleaning. Sitting at kennel door on approach with stiff body, wide eyed, hard staring handler, no interest in treats or coaxing. Presented leash and dog froze in place continuing to hard stare, when lowering loop towards dogs head dog silently lunged forward towards handlers hand bypassing leash, did not make contact, stiff bodied, pacing along kennel wall, attempted to lasso once dog settled and dog silently jumped up lunging towards handlers hand baring teeth once more. Returned with sort board, able to shfit dog over when entering kennel with sort board.
11/12/2026
Was handed to handler by finder. Bit at leash when slight leash pressure applied. Alligator rolled and flailed. Dog expressed anal glands and fear defecated. Growling and screaming. Second handler applied second leash as a precaution. Attempted to use towel wrap restraint, dog thrashed, flailed and screamed. Bit at handler's leg. Used control device to vaccinate. Bit at control device. Thrashed and failed while on control device. Sat in corner lip licking, heavy panting, whale eyes after. Used behavior taxi to transport. Left leash on dog.

Patient resting in kennel. Entered, approached while speaking gently to patient, patient averted gaze, accepted gentle head pets. Allowed leash and muzzle wrap with no reaction. Allowed medication administration (oral, injection) with no reaction. Able to remove leash by hand and gave patient some gentle pets to end interaction.
11/15/2026
Outside for AM cleaning sitting at front of kennel with tense body, whale eye, stoic, very timid. Sniffed treat offered and ate a treat tossed near but did not accept any treats for rest of evaluation, no issues placing leash. Froze in place, does not walk on leash, wide eyed and tensing up body when petted, tolerant of pets but some flinching and skin crawling, no issues muzzle wrapping and carrying into taxi. Observant in taxi, tail tightly tucked, no issues transporting to play yard. In yard dog was distant from handler all of evaluation, scanning environment constantly, paces away from handler if approached but tolerant of pets when near, did not seek out attentions, sits near handler with trembling in back legs. Flinches when startled by loud noises and fast movements, as evaluation progressed dog would have heavy salivation. Able to approach and recover leash, no issues muzzle wrapping but dog did lightly thrash when first picked up to be placed into taxi, settled and rode fine back to kennel, no reaction towards clip leash being attached. Hesitant to enter kennel from taxi, paced out of taxi when handler scooted backside, no issues retrieving leash via clip leash.
11/14/2026
Closed outside for AM cleaning. Dog was lying at kennel door, wide eyed, tense, took treats gently. Came forward slightly when opening door, flinched when placing leash, unable to coax out of kennel, handler positioned taxi, tossed treats inside, dog remained frozen, handler created distance, dog stepped halfway in but wouldn't fully enter taxi, tense and whale eyed when handler approached, flinched when lightly touched, handler held leash taut and gently nudged dog into taxi. Sat up and observed surroundings on the way to yard. Once in yard dog exited taxi, stood in corner, scanning surroundings, ate treats tossed nearby but wouldn't approach using treat trail or verbal coaxing. Handler tried coaxing dog into taxi with more treats, dog remained frozen, whipped head towards handler when trying to pet again, held leash taut and gently nudged into taxi, no issues riding back to kennel, remained frozen in taxi, able to gently guide into kennel, used clip leash.
11/12/2026
Dog was sitting @ front of kennel near kennel wall, slowly closed divider.  Opened gate & presented leash, would become whale eyed while pressing back of body against kennel wall, trembling & licking lips.  Slowly placed large loop leash onto dog, attempted to coax out of kennel verbally, would not walk out of kennel.  Handler repositioned behavior taxi & used a large amount of a treat trail to coax into behavior taxi, dog would slowly start to enter into behavior taxi with treats.  Rode well to small PY.  Would exit into PY & start to explore with nose to ground, keeping tail fully tucked under body, salivating while panting with mouth wide opened & ears shifting from being neutral to flattened.  Would not come towards handler with treats or verbal coaxing.  Handler would approach dog, dog would slowly start to walk backwards while lowering head, flattening ears & starting to tremble body.  Handler would kneel down & offer treats in hand, would sniff but not eat treats from hand, placed treats onto ground, dog would cautiously take treats.  Slowly extended hand to pet on head, would lower head while licking lips & yawning while being pet on head.  Handler would sit back down on chair, dog would start to explore while still keeping distant from handler.  Handler would squeak a toy sound maker, dog would be interested & slowly started to approach handler, sniffing hands, handler moved hands & dog would quickly retreat away from handler while tucking tail tightly under body & pinning ears back. Repositioned behavior taxi & attempted to treat trail dog to enter, would not enter & was not interested in treats.  Able to attach a clip leash to leash then slowly used clip leash to softly muzzle wrap dog.  Gently touched dog on back of body & dog would flip head back towards hands, not making contact then quickly retreated into behavior taxi.  Rode well back to kennel, standing on hind legs, looking around surroundings.  Tolerated petting on back of body while not skin crawling when riding back to kennel.  Entered into kennel & removed leash with use of clip leash.  Offered more treats on ground & closed gate.

11/19/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, standing at front of kennel with soft face, wagging tail. Took treats through gate. Handler cracked gate open, presented leash, dog began pushing snout into gate, then jumping up, eager to exit. Handler had to make a few attempts to place leash due to dog's movements. Once leashed, dog exited quickly, dropped into "bow" position in front of other kennels, tail flagged. Handler called dog away, dog broke focus and walked with moderate pull, hackles raised, tail wagging. Dog attempted to jump up against handler a couple times, handler would keep leash short and turn shoulder away, dog settled. Dog walked well on leash, some pull, tense when passing other dogs. In main play yard, handler dropped leash, dog ran off, then returned to handler, wagging tail. Handler allowed dog to sniff hands without attempting to pet. Dog sniffed hands intently, became stiff, tail tucked, stared up at handler with weight shifted back. Handler spoke softly, shook treat bag, dog shifted attention to treat bag and began softening. Dog watched treat bag with wide eyes, perked ears. Demonstrated "sit" command, eagerly ate treats tossed nearby. Dog flinched away from attempts to pet but stayed near handler while waiting for treats. Dogs outside of yard began getting louder, this dog became tense, tail flagged, chuffing, forward posture towards fence line. Dog turned towards handler, wide-eyed, chuffed once. Handler used treats to break dog's focus, able to lead dog to gate and retrieve leash. Dog walked with light pull, hackles raised but no attempts to engage with kenneled dogs. Tried jumping up on handler while handler was opening alley gate, able to be kept off with short leash. Dog entered own kennel easily, leash removed via clip lead.
11/18/2026
Dog was closed to back half of kennel on approach.  Would dodge leash placement while being whale eyed with ears pinned back & pupils dilated.  Walked with a strong pull on leash to main PY while having ears pinned back, hackles fully raised along the spine, tail tucked under body & head lowered.  Once in PY, dog would start to pace along fence line while panting heavy.  Able to call dog over, offered treats in hand, would take treats in a mouthy manner then return to pacing along fence line.  Dog would approach handler on own while panting heavy with a flagged tail, scattered treats on ground, dog would eat treats while relaxing tail.  Started to explore with nose to ground while having a slow tail wag.  Called dog over, offered more treats in hand then extended hand to pet, dog would flip head back while doing an intense skin crawl each time handler would pet dog, able to remove hands without contact from mouth.  Handler picked up leash & walked dog to small PY.  Dog would continue to pace along fence line.  Appears to know "SIT" for more treats.  Handler would scatter more treats, dog would not settle & was not interested in toys.  Picked up leash & attached a clip leash.  Walked back to kennel while having hackles fully raised along spine again, flagged tail, ears were erect, mouth wide open while panting heavy with a spatula tongue.  Entered into kennel with treats being tossed into kennel.  Removed leash with use of clip leash as dog would start to pull back & thrash on leash.
11/14/2026
Tense body, tail tucked, side eye. Skin crawl, touch sensitivity. Excessive panting, whale eye. Tolerated muzzle wrap for vax. Allowed all handling.
